item.title: Gravenstein Apple Fair 2026 — Sun Aug 9, 10:00 AM — Ragle Ranch Regional Park
item.description:
Join us at the 53rd Anniversary Gravenstein Apple Fair on August 8 & 9 at Ragle Ranch Park in Sebastopol! This year’s theme is “Where Joy Takes Root,” promising cheer, creativity, and community for all! Since 1973, the Gravenstein Apple Fair has brought together farmers, families, musicians, artists, and food lovers to celebrate the agricultural roots of Sonoma County. Gather with us to enjoy all things apple, the best local food and drink, top regional music, ag-inspired fun for all ages, Artisan Tasting Grove, VIP Lounge, and much more! Hailed as Bohemian’s Best Festival since 2019, Best Art Event 2026, and Best Charity Event 2026, the Fair has also been 95% Zero Waste since 2018. Proceeds benefit the nonprofit Sonoma County Farm Trails.
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: The Sonoma County Fair — Sun Aug 9, 10:00 AM — Sonoma County Fairgrounds
item.description:
A celebration of community spirit, agriculture, entertainment, and wholesome fun.
The Sonoma County Fair is an annual event that captivates visitors with its vibrant atmosphere and diverse offerings. Held in scenic Sonoma County, California, this fair is a celebration of community spirit, agriculture, entertainment, and wholesome fun. From thrilling amusement rides and live music performances to engaging exhibits showcasing local produce, crafts, and artwork, the fair offers something for everyone. Attendees can indulge in mouthwatering fair food, participate in thrilling competitions, enjoy live animal exhibits, and explore the region’s rich agricultural heritage. With its charming blend of entertainment and education, the Sonoma County Fair is a must-visit destination that brings joy and excitement to people of all ages.
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.description:

item.title: Beginning Gel Printing Workshop — Mon Aug 17, 1:00 PM — Rileystreet Art Supply
item.description:
Instructor: Magdalena Bogart Monday, August 17th 1:00pm-4:00PM Location: Santa Rosa Store $45.00
Join us for an inspiring gel printing workshop with Magdalena Bogart, where you'll discover the magic of this versatile and expressive art form. You will learn techniques for creating stunning, layered prints using gel plates, rich textures, and vibrant colors. If you have wanted to try out this fairly new and very popular way to make your own papers, whether you are an experienced artist or simply curious about the process, this workshop will provide plenty of creative inspiration and expert insights.
During the 3-hours workshop, you will learn the fundamentals of mono-printing with a gel plate, including an in-depth look at the essential supplies needed. Magdalena will discuss different types of plates and brayers, as well as the wide range of acrylic paints and inks. You will learn the basics of color theory to ensure great results for your projects.
